en: A color winter street scene in a small town: snow-covered road, pedestrians in winter clothing, several 1960s–1970s cars, and low-rise brick and stone buildings. On the left is a red-brick building with a large circular ESSO gas-station sign and a sign for a Taverna. On the right is a substantial stone building with a vertical neon sign reading "BANK". Farther along the street are more commercial buildings, one with a light tower-like structure. The image has the look of a printed tourist postcard.
